mathematicalChecks.sourceMeanPayment: (n|mu|)^2<=1 and 3/4<=n*m2 imply n*mu^2<=(4/3)*m2; m<=n implies (m|mu|)^2<=(4/3)*T<=(16/3)*S, hence m|mu|<=4*sqrt(S).
mathematicalChecks.sourceFrequencyPayment: kappa/gamma<=|u|, positive gamma, kappa*sqrt(L2)>=1 and L2*gamma^2<=T imply 1<=|u|^2*T<=4*|u|^2*S, hence 1<=2*|u|*sqrt(S).
mathematicalChecks.sourceClockComparison: 0<S<=T<=4S; inverse-sixth-power denominator comparison costs 4^6; sqrt(S)<=sqrt(T) and S<=T pay numerators.
